verdicts.reason: A keeps the original headline, badge and CTA at their original proportions, but it spreads the group out: there is too big a gap between the headline and the button, and the bottom third of the square is dead space, so it reads as the banner dropped onto a bigger canvas rather than a recomposed design. B enlarges the headline well, but it shrinks the 'See the Flavours' CTA and the LIMITED badge until they are tiny, pushes them almost to the bottom edge, and moves the badge to the right of the button; the badge is now nearly unreadable and the CTA is buried, with a large empty gap between it and the headline.
